parts.refutation: Input withstand fails: the INA238's differential-input absolute maximum rating is only -40 V to +40 V between IN+ and IN- (SLYS025B s5.1), and the datasheet's own filter guidance ('Do not use values greater than 100 ohm for RFILTER', s7.1.4) rules out adding enough series resistance on a 5 mA/pin input to survive an 85 V fault safely. This is the same failure the shortlist already reports and leaves open (decision 'none', reported to the owner, not replaced) -- my re-reading confirms the datasheet figures behind that finding are accurate.
